name: Brendan Coles
org: Independent security researcher; WhatWeb co-developer; Metasploit Framework contributor
why_notable: Co-developer of WhatWeb alongside Andrew Horton. He wrote and maintained a large share of its roughly 1800 fingerprint plugins and is credited as co-author in the README, the man page and many plugin headers. Outside WhatWeb he is a prolific contributor of exploit and post-exploitation modules to the Metasploit Framework, which links fingerprinting (what is this site running?) with exploitation (which modules apply?).
